evals.name: fresh-project-scaffold
evals.prompt: /valcraft:forge — new project: "pagewatch", a CLI that watches a list of URLs and emails a diff when a page changes. Primary user: me. MVP: add a URL, run one check cycle, receive one diff email end to end. Stack: Python 3.12, no framework, SQLite, runs from cron. No public API, no domain-heavy vocabulary.
evals.expected_output: Forge gathers no redundant facts (the prompt answers Step 1), presents the proposed scaffold with assumptions and TBDs, waits for approval, then creates exactly the approved skeleton: README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md symlink to AGENTS.md, .gitignore, docs/product-brief.md, docs/plans/, docs/architecture/overview.md, docs/architecture/adr/README.md, and specs/001-mvp/ with spec.md, design.md, tasks.md. Templates are filled from the stated facts; unknowns are recorded as assumptions or TBD, never invented. No implementation code, no commit, no push. The run ends with a report of created/merged/skipped/blocked paths and MVP readiness.
assertions: The proposed scaffold, assumptions, and TBDs are presented before any file is written, and creation waits for approval
All skeleton paths are created, including specs/001-mvp/ with spec.md, design.md, and tasks.md
CLAUDE.md is a relative symlink to AGENTS.md
docs/architecture/overview.md and docs/architecture/adr/README.md are created from the skill's templates
Task IDs use the T- prefix (T-001…), matching the FR-/AC- convention
No requirement is invented — unknowns appear as assumptions or TBD in the spec
No implementation code is written, and nothing is committed or pushed
The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths plus MVP readiness

evals.name: retrofit-existing-repo
evals.prompt: /valcraft:forge — retrofit spec-driven structure onto the existing repo at evals/files/retrofit-repo/. It already has a README, an AGENTS.md with build commands and a store-boundary rule, and a separate CLAUDE.md with commit conventions.
evals.expected_output: Forge derives project facts from the repo before asking anything, presents the proposed changes and waits for approval, then merges instead of overwriting: README keeps its content and gains documentation links; AGENTS.md keeps the npm commands and the src/store.js boundary rule and absorbs the missing template sections; the distinct CLAUDE.md content (Conventional Commits, no-new-dependencies rule) is merged into AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md is replaced with the symlink only after the user approves removing the distinct file. As-built state goes to overview.md and retroactive ADRs; no retro-spec of existing behavior is written.
assertions: Project facts are derived from the repo first; the user is asked only what the repo cannot answer
Proposed changes are presented and approved before any file is modified
The existing AGENTS.md content (npm commands, src/store.js boundary rule) survives the merge — nothing is silently overwritten
The distinct CLAUDE.md rules (Conventional Commits, no new dependencies without asking) are merged into AGENTS.md, not lost
CLAUDE.md is replaced with the symlink only after explicit user approval of removing the distinct existing file
README.md keeps its original content and gains documentation links
No spec is written for existing behavior — the first spec, if any, describes the next planned change
The final report lists created, merged, skipped, and blocked paths
